premeasurement_amendments: Initial launch stopped at a pre-render camera-membership assertion because the A-only loader correctly did not construct B camera objects. No renderer call or image metric was produced. Corrected the assertion to require construction of A cameras only, keeping B unread until the A gate passes; the frozen sampling, thresholds, and selection rules are unchanged. Updated script hash before any A measurement.
question: Can a fixed-state rule find a batch of 16 high accepted-pixel-cost Gaussians whose temporary opacity suppression measurably improves training-view loss, then retain that effect on separately sampled training views?
scope: Static, in-memory interventions on the corrected author FastGS room@10K PLY. No training update, no optimizer or topology event, and no full-training speed or final-quality claim.

render_and_loss.optimization_loss: 0.8 * mean(abs(render - target)) + 0.2 * (1 - fused_ssim(render, target)); use original unclamped render/target values, as in the FastGS training loss
render_and_loss.reported_psnr: clamp rendered and target RGB to [0,1], then compute full-image RGB PSNR
render_and_loss.opacity_intervention: For one PLY row at a time, fill only raw model._opacity[index] with -20.0 in memory, render, then immediately restore and assert bitwise tensor equality.
render_and_loss.pixel_work_proxy: All-ones int32 metric_map with render_fastgs(get_flag=True); use accum_metric_counts as accepted Gaussian-pixel contribution counts. This is not a tile-instance count or wall-clock speedup.

sampling.training_camera_order_before_sampling: lexicographically sorted image_name list from the frozen Colmap eval=True split
sampling.draw_rule: Permute the 272 sorted training names once without replacement. First 8 form A, next 8 form B. Sort each set only for execution order; retain draw order below.
sampling.heldout_policy: The 39 development/test cameras are excluded from rule construction, candidate selection, thresholds, and evaluation. The diagnostic-heldout outlier DSCF4771 and prior candidate 689298 are not used as an input or special case. B is not read until A selects at least 16 candidates.

A_gate.repeat_noise: For each A camera, compute the maximum absolute deviation of the three no-edit losses from their median. noise_max is the maximum across A cameras.
A_gate.visibility_eligibility: A Gaussian must have radius > 0 in at least 2 of the 8 A views.
A_gate.cost_scan: One baseline all-ones accepted-pixel counter render per A camera. Candidate cost is the sum of accepted pixel contributions across the 8 A views.
A_gate.candidate_pool: The 64 visibility-eligible Gaussians with greatest A accepted-pixel cost; ties break by ascending PLY index.
A_gate.intervention: For each candidate, render each A camera once with only that row's raw opacity temporarily set to -20.0; restore after each render.
A_gate.qualifies: Mean across the 8 per-camera intervention-minus-median-baseline original-loss deltas is <= -epsilon, AND at least one A camera has delta <= -1e-5.
A_gate.selection: If fewer than 16 candidates qualify, stop immediately and do not access B. Otherwise choose the 16 qualifying candidates with greatest A accepted-pixel cost, ties by ascending PLY index; freeze IDs before B.
A_gate.selection_cost_accounting: Record baseline repeats, accepted-pixel scan renders, all candidate intervention renders, synchronized per-render and stage wall time, and all rule computation time where measurable.

B_gate_if_A_passes.threshold_source: Use epsilon frozen from A only; do not estimate or adjust a threshold from B.
B_gate_if_A_passes.main_group: Suppress all 16 frozen A-selected rows simultaneously.
B_gate_if_A_passes.additional_group: Suppress the 15 highest-A-cost rows among the selected 16 (the 16th is dropped); no B result can change this set.
B_gate_if_A_passes.individual_interventions: Measure each of the 16 frozen rows separately on all 8 B cameras.
B_gate_if_A_passes.per_camera_report: For every B camera report original-loss delta and clamped PSNR delta for the main 16-point group, 15-point group, and each single point.
B_gate_if_A_passes.main_group_quality_pass: At least 6/8 B cameras have original-loss delta <= epsilon; at least 2/8 have PSNR delta >= +0.05 dB; mean original-loss delta is <= -epsilon; and mean PSNR delta is > +0.05 dB.
B_gate_if_A_passes.net_cost_measurement: For baseline, 16-point group, and 15-point group, rerender each B camera with an all-ones get_flag metric_map. Report the direct net change in total accepted Gaussian-pixel contributions after the group edit. Do not add single-point costs to estimate group savings.

conditional_controls.run_condition: Run only if the 16-point main group passes every B quality gate. If A or the B main gate fails, do not spend GPU time on controls.
conditional_controls.candidate_universe: The frozen A top-64 cost pool; no B quantities enter control selection.
conditional_controls.highest_cost_16: Top 16 in the pool by A accepted-pixel cost, ties by PLY index.
conditional_controls.lowest_opacity_16: 16 lowest sigmoid(opacity) in the pool, ties by PLY index.
conditional_controls.random_16: Sample 16 without replacement from the pool after excluding the main 16, using PCG64 seed 20260928.
conditional_controls.cost_matched_16: From pool rows outside the main 16, use deterministic one-for-one swaps initialized with the 16 closest individual costs to target_mean = main-group total cost / 16; iterate the cost-reducing swap with lexicographically smallest (added_index, removed_index) until no swap improves absolute group-total cost error. Report remaining mismatch.
conditional_controls.author_rule_control: Adapted FastGS final-prune branch only: evaluate the author's pruning_score on 10 fixed training cameras drawn without replacement from the sorted training names left after A/B using PCG64 seed 20260929, with the author's loss_thresh and mult. Eligible rows in the A top-64 pool satisfy sigmoid(opacity) < 0.1 OR pruning_score > 0.9. If >=16 qualify, use the 16 highest pruning_score rows (ties by PLY index); otherwise evaluate the smaller eligible set and report the shortfall. This is not an exact replay of the 10K event because the PLY lacks historical max_radii2D/densification state.
conditional_controls.comparison: On B, report each control's full-image quality changes and direct all-ones group accepted-pixel change. Include each method's selection/scoring render count, synchronized time, and GPU work. State explicitly if any conditional control is unavailable or not run.

execution.launch_gate: Immediately before the first GPU render, recheck physical GPU 2 is idle and has no competing workload. Never use physical GPUs 0 or 1; do not interrupt other processes.
execution.baseline_integrity: Do not edit author source or PLY. Record PLY SHA-256 before/after. No checkpoint or PLY output is written.

interpretation_limits: Static image-loss interventions do not show that pruning is safe after optimizer and scene state evolve.
Accepted pixel contribution counts are a work proxy, not tile-instance counts or measured training speed.
A/B views are training views; they are not official novel-view test evidence.
No complete training run is part of this experiment.
